version.promotionalText: Run any credit move before you make it — see likely direction, risk, and your next best step. Free, private, no credit pull.
version.description:
Know the likely credit impact before you make the move.

Limitless Credit GPS is a free credit education and decision simulator. Answer a 60-second quiz — no account, no SSN, no credit pull — and get a personalized plan with your estimated risk level and next best move.

What you can do:

- Simulate 11 common credit moves before you act: pay off a card, open or close a card, request a limit increase, pay a collection, consolidate debt, apply for a mortgage, and more
- See likely direction, confidence, risk, and timing for each move in plain English — never fake point predictions
- Understand sudden score changes with the Why Did My Score Drop explainer
- Follow a step-by-step action plan matched to your goal: buy a home, buy a car, rebuild credit, fix collections, build from scratch, get better rates, business funding, or apartment approval
- Learn the fundamentals in 15 two-minute lessons written in plain English
- Save simulations to your plan and track progress

Private by design: everything you enter stays on your device. No registration, no ads, no tracking.

Limitless Credit GPS provides educational estimates based on common credit scoring factors. It does not guarantee score changes, credit approvals, account removals, or financial outcomes, and it does not provide financial, credit repair, or legal advice.

Privacy Policy: https://eb28.co/limitless/privacy/
Terms: https://eb28.co/limitless/terms/

notes: Version 1.0.0 build 2. No login, no account, no payment. The full experience is available immediately on first launch.
The app is a self-contained credit education and decision simulator. All content and simulation logic run on-device; user answers are stored locally and never uploaded.
Core flow: tap Start My Credit GPS, pick a goal, answer the 11-question profile quiz (about 60 seconds), and the app builds a personalized plan with an estimated risk level and next best move.

From the dashboard: Run a Credit Move simulates 11 common credit decisions (payoff, open/close card, limit increase, pay collection, consolidate, mortgage application, missed payment) and returns likely direction, confidence, risk, and timing with plain-English explanations. The app deliberately never shows fake point predictions.
Why Did My Score Drop matches recent events to common causes. Learn contains 15 original educational lessons. My Plan tracks action items and saved simulations.

The app does not access credit reports, does not connect to credit bureaus, and does not provide credit repair services. Educational disclaimers are shown on the welcome screen, quiz, results, and footer.
Privacy policy, terms, and support links are in the app footer and open in Safari: https://eb28.co/limitless/privacy/
The app declares ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption = NO (standard HTTPS only).
